title: fix(desktop): invalidate skill-suggestion cache on soft re-home
claim: The skill-suggestion index (5-min module cache) must be dropped when the desktop re-homes to another profile or connection, so a stale 'Use skill' pill cannot insert a /skill the new backend lacks.

evidence.red: NOT_TESTED (owned upstream). Need confirmed by source: main apps/desktop/src/store/suggestion-providers/skill.ts invalidateSkillSuggestionIndex() is only called from gateway-event/tools.ts (skill_manage); store/profile.ts profile-change block (L456-468) and gateway-switch.ts wipeSessionListsForGatewaySwitch() call neither it nor the MCP equivalent.

upstream_overlap: #85253 (OPEN, pierrenode, 2026-08-13) 'fix(desktop): invalidate composer suggestion-provider caches on profile switch' calls invalidateSkillSuggestionIndex() and invalidateMcpSuggestionIndex() from the existing $activeGatewayProfile chokepoint in store/profile.ts, with a mutation-verified test. It owns the profile-swap half and is the better placement than the fork's separate subscription in skill.ts.
notes: Review-support value: the fork's second hook, invalidateSkillSuggestionIndex() inside gateway-switch.ts wipeSessionListsForGatewaySwitch(), covers the connection/mode switch where both connections expose the same profile key (e.g. 'default'). #85253's profile-key gate does not fire in that case. Worth offering on #85253 as a suggested sibling (MCP cache too), not as a competing PR. Kanban baggage ignored.
